envelope.description: Spike the claude/codex structured-stream + native-resume contract; capture fixtures

body.title: Spike the claude/codex structured-stream + native-resume contract; capture fixtures
body.summary: Run a throwaway spike against the installed claude/codex CLIs to pin the exact structured-stream invocation flags (e.g. claude --output-format stream-json) and the native session-resume mechanism, and capture representative native-stream sample lines as test fixtures under vscode-plugin/src/chat/__tests__/fixtures/. Spike code is discarded; only the findings + fixtures are kept.
acceptanceChecks: The exact per-provider structured-stream flags + native resume flag/id are documented (in the adapter's comments / a short note)
Representative native-stream fixtures for claude (and codex if available) are captured for the unit tests
No throwaway spike code remains in the shipped source

tests.name: opt-in: real claude/codex structured-stream invocation emits parseable events the mapper turns into TurnEvents
opt-in: real native session-resume yields a usable SessionHandle (or the provider is marked resume:false)
